summary: Comprehensive testing of Aegis Protocol Phase 2 features completed successfully. All new backend APIs and frontend functionality working correctly including tf-001 Transformer model, Binance integration, referral/staking systems, and WebSocket streaming.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/models returns 4 models including tf-001 Delta Transformer
Backend: GET /api/signals/generate/tf-001 generates Transformer signal with prediction fields
Backend: GET /api/binance/ticker/bitcoin returns Binance ticker with price, volume, high/low
Backend: GET /api/binance/klines/bitcoin?interval=1h&limit=10 returns kline candles
Backend: GET /api/binance/depth/bitcoin returns order book bids and asks
Backend: GET /api/binance/trades/bitcoin returns recent trades
Backend: POST /api/referral/register with wallet_address returns referral_code and tier
Backend: POST /api/staking/stake with wallet_address and amount creates stake with APY
Backend: GET /api/tokens/{wallet} returns token balance, tier, and voting_power
Backend: POST /api/contracts/deployed tracks contract deployment with network info
Backend: GET /api/contracts returns deployed contracts list
Backend: GET /api/signals/generate/lstm-001 still works correctly (regression test)
Backend: All existing Phase 1 endpoints continue to work (health, market data, DAO, allocations, executions, admin)
Frontend: Dashboard shows Binance ticker bar at top with real price data and 24h change
Frontend: Dashboard shows 'WS LIVE' indicator when WebSocket connects
Frontend: Dashboard tabs include 'Live Stream' and 'Binance Data' with functional panels
Frontend: Model selector includes tf-001 Delta Transformer option
Frontend: Generate Signal button displays signal data with gatekeeper factors and analysis
Frontend: Staking page loads with token balance cards (AEGIS Tokens, Tier, Voting Power, Total Staked)
Frontend: Staking page has functional staking form with amount input and stake button
Frontend: Marketplace shows 4 model cards including Delta Transformer
Frontend: Developer page has Transformer as model type option in dropdown
Frontend: DAO page shows proposals section (currently empty with 'No proposals at the moment')
Frontend: Smart Contracts tab shows ModelRegistry, VotingContract, and VerificationStorage cards
Frontend: All navigation between pages works correctly
Frontend: WebSocket streaming functionality integrated with live signals display

success_percentage.backend: 100% (25/25 endpoints tested including all Phase 2 features)
